visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with stylized dark hair and decorative white dots under his eyes presses his lips firmly against a transparent acrylic sheet held by his hands. He is in a studio setting with a clean gray background. (2) He smiles and holds up a fan of several black and gradient lip stain tubes. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting his smooth skin and makeup. (3) On-screen overlays appear showing portraits of several other beauty influencers, suggesting their endorsement of the product. (4) A close-up shot of the man's inner forearm displays ten distinct swatches of lip colors, numbered from #01 to #004, ranging from corals to deep berries. (5) He holds a single black lip stain tube with the 'TIME PHORIA' logo and demonstrates the applicator, which has a slanted cotton tip. (6) Detailed close-up shots show him applying a dark berry shade (#08) to his lips, carefully outlining and then filling them. (7) He performs a 'cruel transfer test' by pressing the acrylic sheet against his freshly painted lips again to show no residue is left. (8) He repeats the application process with a more natural nude rose shade (#11) and gives a thumbs up to the camera with a confident smile.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A young Asian male with trendy dark hair, wearing a black t-shirt. He has stylized makeup including white dots under his eyes and is demonstrating lip products.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A clean, solid light-gray studio background that provides high contrast for the subject.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a high-energy male narrator speaking in a bright, friendly tone. He is accompanied by an upbeat electronic pop BGM with a consistent 128 BPM beat. A sharp 'pop' sound effect coincides with the visual kiss mark on the acrylic. (2) As the scene transitions to the creator holding multiple tubes, a synthesized 'whoosh' SFX bridges the cut. The narration speed is fast and enthusiastic, emphasizing the popularity of the brand. (3) A clear 'ding' sound accompanies the appearance of the product logo and text overlay. The BGM maintains a steady, driving rhythm with bright synth leads. (4) During the arm swatch demonstration, the voice exhibits a slightly more descriptive, instructional tone while maintaining high arousal. Occasional 'thud' or 'click' sounds from handling the tubes are audible but secondary. (5) As he applies the berry shade, the audio focuses on his voice explaining the texture, punctuated by digital transition SFX and a final vocal 'pop' or smacking sound to emphasize the finish.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Hook -> Intro -> Proof -> Variety Demo -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To demonstrate the long-wear, transfer-proof quality and vibrant color selection of TIME PHORIA Stellar Dust Lip Stain through high-energy influencer-style presentation.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct demonstration of the product, naming the brand, and encouraging viewers to try it.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A professional beauty social media ad featuring fast cuts, high-energy narration, and clear visual demonstrations of product benefits (non-transfer) to maximize viewer retention.
